name: benethos-lexware-office-mcp
description: Unofficial MCP server for the Lexware Office accounting API — runs over stdio or HTTP.
long_description: Not affiliated with Lexware. **Nothing is enabled after installing**, so Claude Desktop shows the server as failed until you choose its tools. Pick the prompt **Set up Lexware Office** under the plus in the message box: it opens the configuration interface in your browser, where you enter the API key and decide which tools exist. Both apply at once. A key changed later applies after quitting Claude Desktop from the tray and starting it again.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Show which Lexware Office account this server is connected to.

tools.name: search_contacts
tools.description: Find contacts by name, email address, number or role.

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Read one contact in full, by id.

tools.name: create_contact
tools.description: Create a new customer or vendor in the account.

tools.name: update_contact
tools.description: Change an existing contact.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: List articles, filtered by number, barcode or kind.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Read one article in full, by id.

tools.name: create_article
tools.description: Add an article to the catalogue.

tools.name: update_article
tools.description: Change an article.

tools.name: delete_article
tools.description: Delete an article.

tools.name: search_vouchers
tools.description: Find invoices, credit notes, quotations and bookkeeping vouchers.

tools.name: get_voucher
tools.description: Read one bookkeeping voucher, by id or by its document number.

tools.name: get_payments
tools.description: Show whether a voucher has been paid, and what is still open.

tools.name: create_voucher
tools.description: Record a bookkeeping voucher in the account.

tools.name: update_voucher
tools.description: Change a bookkeeping voucher that is already recorded.

tools.name: get_sales_document
tools.description: Read one sales document in full: an invoice, quotation or their kin.

tools.name: create_sales_document
tools.description: Create an invoice, quotation, credit note or one of their relatives.

tools.name: get_recurring_templates
tools.description: Read the templates that issue invoices on a schedule.

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Save a stored file, such as an uploaded receipt.

tools.name: download_document
tools.description: Save the rendered PDF of an invoice or another sales document.

tools.name: read_download
tools.description: Put the contents of a downloaded file into this conversation.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Upload a receipt, which also creates a bookkeeping voucher for it.

tools.name: attach_file_to_voucher
tools.description: Attach a file to a voucher that already exists.

tools.name: get_deeplink
tools.description: Build a link that opens a record in the Lexware Office web app.

tools.name: get_master_data
tools.description: Read one of the lists this account is configured with.

prompts.name: open_setup
prompts.description: Opens the configuration interface in the browser.
prompts.text: The configuration interface of the Lexware Office MCP server is open in the browser, where the person sets the API key and which tools exist. Nothing needs to be done in this conversation.
